evidence.reason: The inventory collects only LoadState/ActiveState/UnitFileState/FragmentPath. A systemd drop-in in another unit-load directory can override the timer's trigger target while FragmentPath remains unchanged; the adapter's drop-in scan covers only its local dropin_dir, so the "exact allowlisted topology" inventory misses an effective override and can fence/accept the wrong unit. Checking DropInPaths and the effective timer target is a routine correctness fix.
